overview: Mithila, a strongly willed and emotionally guarded woman, unexpectedly reunites with her college crush, Ram during a job interview. She hires him, quietly hoping to rekindle what she once felt. At work, her hidden affection clashes with Ram’s emotional distance, often leading to unintentional hurt. Determined to get closer, Mithila convinces him to go on a long drive. As they begin to connect, their journey takes a dark turn when their car breaks down in a remote village and terror strikes the couple, pulling Ram into a tense and unsettling search for Mithila.
title: Ala Chere Seetha Ramuni Chentaku
